issues: The verse summarizes many battles over time; the permitted single-battle visual inference should not imply these battles happened simultaneously.
The verse does not specify when or where the remainder usurped authority or when and where the deaths by fire occurred; keep the visual limited to their flight as noted.
The source reports that believers were put to death but does not specify a location or execution moment; the narration correctly avoids staging one.
The verse gives a sequence of contention, hunting, slaying, and flight without precise timing or placement; avoid presenting all as simultaneous.
The reported pursuit has no specified time or location; avoid staging it as a precisely located or timed event. The sheep comparison is figurative, as noted.
The return, dwelling, and joining occur in sequence. The scene correctly selects the joining, but the source does not specify which of the two named lands is shown.
The verse does not specify where or how the weapons were buried; avoid implying a particular place or ceremony.
The passage describes belief and practice but does not name participants or specify visible outward performances; keep any visual setting neutral and avoid inventing a ritual.
The source does not specify the missionaries' location or how they expressed joy; avoid adding a setting or specific gestures as facts.
